summary: Validated CONTINUAR button fix on /inscricao.html. Disabled state renders gray (rgb(158,173,188)) with white text readable and cursor:not-allowed. When all required fields are filled and #declaracao_veracidade is checked, the button becomes enabled with backgroundColor rgb(0,45,77) navy, color rgb(255,255,255), opacity 1 — no more white-on-white invisibility bug. Clicking CONTINUAR navigates successfully to /dados-inscricao.html (step 3, 'Dados da Inscrição' heading and stepper 3 active). Regression check: only one 'Escolher arquivo' button per DOC_FRENTE/DOC_VERSO field, and file name appears in green after attaching.
critical_code_review_comments: The CSS specificity fix via inline <style id='btn-continuar-fix'> works, but consider consolidating button color rules into the main stylesheet to avoid future conflicts.

Cloudflare Insights beacon and challenge-platform scripts are blocked by CSP (script-src 'unsafe-inline' data:). Non-blocking but noisy — consider adjusting CSP or removing CF references from static pages.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for CONTINUAR button visibility on /inscricao.html is fully verified. Navigation to /dados-inscricao.html confirmed. Test flow: fill NOME/CPF(52998224725)/DATA(10091990)/SEXO index1/CEP(66017000)+blur/NUMERO/CELULAR/EMAIL, select DOC_TIPO=RG, upload files to DOC_FRENTE and DOC_VERSO, check #declaracao_veracidade — btn-salvar becomes enabled with navy bg + white text.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: an earlier CSS rule was rendering #btn-salvar with white background AND white text when enabled, making CONTINUAR invisible (white-on-white). Fix applied via a high-specificity <style id='btn-continuar-fix'> block forcing #frm-style-list input#btn-salvar { background:#002D4D; color:#fff } for enabled state and gray (#aab7c4) with opacity:1 for :disabled. Verified via getComputedStyle at runtime.
